told.text: GOAL: We are building a fully functioning backgammon game using Node.js and TypeScript, served and played in the browser — a complete, playable game from the opening position through rolling dice, moving checkers around the board, bearing off, and winning.
PROBLEM: The game is not fully functional yet and requires work.
TASK: Here are the problems that require attention:

Before the list: every time I check, I run your latest code from scratch and start a brand-new game. I play it on an ordinary laptop screen — 1280×800, and 1440×900. I play white: my checkers travel anticlockwise, from point 24 around to point 1, and black's travel the opposite way round, from point 1 up to point 24.
My software team ran your app through their own checks — on the code underneath it and on exact measurements of the page — and found these problems:

1) Their checks of the page: after New Game the end pop-up is out of sight but modalOverlay does not carry the hidden class. The brief has the end pop-up shown and hidden by toggling the hidden class on modalOverlay, and their software reads that class.
They work from the written spec for this app, against the code exactly as it is right now, on a clean checkout — so if they can't find something, it isn't there to find.
While you fix these, keep what the team's software depends on exactly as it is — don't rename or remove any of it:

- the data-testid tags: scoreWhite, scoreBlack, difficulty, newGameBtn, board, playfield, checkerLayer, pointHints, turnIndicator, pipWhite, pipBlack, cube, cubeVal, cubeOwner, dice, rollBtn, doubleBtn, undoBtn, endTurnBtn, message, modalOverlay, modalTitle, modalBody, modalBtns; and on the dynamic elements point, checker, hint, die, bar, off-tray, off-you, checkerCount, fastForwardBtn
- the ids of the static elements above, each the same string as its tag

- the routes: POST /api/state, /api/new, /api/roll, /api/move, /api/undo, /api/endturn, /api/double, /api/double/respond, /api/ai, and GET /health; and, with DEBUG_API=1, POST /api/debug/state and POST /api/debug/roll

- the fields every response returns: points, bar, off, turn, phase, dice, remainingDice, cube, difficulty, score, winner, winType, pointsWon, doubleOfferedBy, message, turnOver, gamesPlayed, pip, legalMoves, canDouble
